searches.query: OpenAI Codex changelog and update posture
searches.phase_reflection: Use the latest verified Codex app and CLI posture as a moving surface; avoid stale route assumptions after app updates.
searches.runner_implication: Keep Browser and CLI route receipts timestamped and refresh-before-unavailable.

searches.query: OpenAI Codex follow goal use case
searches.phase_reflection: Goal work needs a durable objective and a verifiable stopping condition rather than repeated manual restarts.
searches.runner_implication: Keep full v544-v575 goal open until verified v575-gmut-thos-v8-x2 closeout.

searches.phase_reflection: Goal control can be paused or resumed while follow-up steering continues in the same thread.
searches.runner_implication: Treat Hamish follow-ups as steering constraints without resetting phase truth.

searches.phase_reflection: Long-running work should preserve a clear definition of done and pause safely before connectivity risk.
searches.runner_implication: Every compact/startup/closeout receipt must carry next phase and open-gate state.

searches.phase_reflection: The in-app Browser is a shared rendered page surface and must be refreshed with visible page state before action.
searches.runner_implication: duo route checks use fresh DOM/status refresh and no reload during active response.

searches.query: OpenAI Codex app computer and browser use
searches.phase_reflection: Multiple tool surfaces can coexist, but the phase route should prefer the current proven surface.
searches.runner_implication: Keep Browser for Lumen and avoid stale manual fallback unless retry receipts require it.

searches.phase_reflection: CLI workflows are separate from app Browser work and should not be conflated with ChatGPT main-thread routing.
searches.runner_implication: Keep strict CLI and Browser receipt classes separate in phase artifacts.

searches.query: OpenAI Codex CLI slash goal commands
searches.source: OpenAI Developers Codex CLI slash commands
searches.phase_reflection: Goal mode has explicit pause, resume, and clear semantics.
searches.runner_implication: Do not claim goal completion before the final verified phase.

searches.phase_reflection: Branches are refs pointing at commits, so Lumen-owned write lanes can be represented as explicit branch refs.
searches.runner_implication: Use lumen-only branches for write scope and shared branches as read-only context.

searches.source: GitHub Docs personal repository permission levels
searches.phase_reflection: Repository permission models may not exactly match desired per-branch sibling lanes on personal accounts.
searches.runner_implication: Record Lumen write posture as branch-scoped operational policy, not a claim of account-level permission mutation.

searches.phase_reflection: Content reads and writes should be explicit and auditable.
searches.runner_implication: Keep Lumen's GitHub write lane limited to sanitized branch content and never raw private local state.

searches.phase_reflection: Branch listing can be read-only and is useful for keeping current with latest sanitized state.
searches.runner_implication: Ask Lumen to check latest shared branch truth read-only before proposing x1 corrections.

searches.phase_reflection: Granular roles are organization-specific and should not be assumed for every repository shape.
searches.runner_implication: Avoid claiming external account or permission mutation unless exact admin action is requested and verified.

searches.phase_reflection: Rulesets can govern branch interaction and are relevant to future branch safety design.
searches.runner_implication: Queue branch-protection/ruleset changes as exact-approval work, not automatic safe-now work.

searches.phase_reflection: Locators provide current element resolution and are better than stale DOM guesses.
searches.runner_implication: Use fresh snapshot/status and verify unique composer/send controls before Browser actions.

searches.phase_reflection: Filling contenteditable elements is a supported route when textarea wrappers are hidden or zero-size.
searches.runner_implication: Preserve contenteditable fallback as the staple duo route after fresh refresh.

searches.phase_reflection: Runtime evaluation can time out during active app work and should not trigger duplicate sends.
searches.runner_implication: If post-send evaluation times out, probe non-destructively and record active/open state.

searches.phase_reflection: Browser instrumentation is powerful but needs conservative state checks around side effects.
searches.runner_implication: Prefer smallest safe Browser probes and no reload during active response.

searches.phase_reflection: Network-level introspection can expose sensitive request data and should not be dumped into artifacts.
searches.runner_implication: Keep Browser receipts compact and avoid raw network/session state publication.

searches.phase_reflection: GitHub automation should be explicit, scoped, and rate-aware.
searches.runner_implication: Use sanitized GitHub branch lanes and queue permission/account mutations for exact approval.
